title: A Unified Framework for Wasserstein Convergence of ULMC Methods beyond Log-Concavity: Old and New
summary: As a fundamental task across computational statistics, scientific computing and machine learning, sampling from high-dimensional probability distributions has received increasing attention in recent years. Numerous sampling algorithms have been proposed, among which underdamped Langevin Monte Carlo (ULMC) methods based on underdamped Langevin dynamics (ULD) have emerged as a class of efficient ones.
